subject: [PATCH v6 07/19] selftests/mm: move is_backed_by_folio() into vm_util

2026-09-19.patch_summary: This patch moves a utility function called is_backed_by_folio() from the split_huge_page_test.c file to the vm_util.c file in the selftests/mm directory. The function checks if an address range is backed by a folio of a given order, which is useful for tests that build or collapse large folios. The patch does not introduce any functional changes and makes the utility function available for use in other tests.
